svg.title: Lead Generation Agent
svg.desc: Lead Generation Agent — browser automation. Turns “find gyms in Karachi” into a formatted Excel sheet of leads, scraped from Google Maps with retrying browser automation and email discovery. Pipeline: prompt → query parser → Google Maps → scrape + emails → Excel. Built with Python, Playwright, BeautifulSoup, openpyxl.
svg.text: Turns “find gyms in Karachi” into a formatted Excel
sheet of leads, scraped from Google Maps with
retrying browser automation and email discovery.
